subject: Re: Mutual action plan & evaluation timeline — FinServe (audit logs, retention, premium controls)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Hughes <clara.hughes@finserve.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan draft & evaluation kickoff — FinServe

Hi Clara —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and an initial pricing snapshot for the evaluation period. High level:

- 4-week evaluation starting 3/1 to 3/28 focused on latency and cost-per-token for your customer support models
- Security review (SOC2 questionnaire + sample audit logs) to be completed during week 2 of the eval
- If evaluation metrics meet the success criteria (latency < 250ms p95; embedding recall within 2 points), we propose a commercial kickoff with a phased ramp starting 4/1

Attachments: MAP_FinServe_v1.pdf, pricing_table_v1.xlsx

Quick asks from your side:
1) Confirm evaluation start date (we proposed 3/1)
2) Procurement contact for contracts/SOW (cc'd if different)
3) Any additional security controls beyond audit logs and retention that you need to see in the eval

I looped Priyom for a quick technical checklist and Neha on pricing. We'll use the MAP to tie specific pricing/discount milestones to commits and ramp.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan draft & evaluation kickoff — FinServe

Monica —

Thanks, this looks good. A couple of technical notes I will include in the MAP:

- Audit logs: we can provide line-item event logs (request metadata, model variant, token counts) via S3 export. Default retention 90 days in hosted, can extend to 13 months as an add-on.
- Retention pricing: suggest $0.12/GB/month beyond the bundled 90-day window; archival export flat fee $500 one-time if they want a snapshot.
- Premium admin controls (role-based access, IP allowlist, HSM integration) will be packaged as "Premium Controls" at $1,500/month.
- For evaluation we can enable a 30-day retention window and provide sample audit exports. If Procurement wants longer retention during the eval, we can enable at no charge for the 4-week eval (one-time accommodation) so they can validate retention workflow.

I'll attach a quick tech appendix for the MAP and a sample audit log CSV schema.

— Priyom
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

From: Clara Hughes <clara.hughes@finserve.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@finserve.com>, Jose Ramirez <j.ramirez@finserve.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan draft & evaluation kickoff — FinServe

Monica —

Appreciate the draft. A couple items from our side before we confirm 3/1 start:

- Procurement asked for a clearer breakdown on how discounts are tied to MAP milestones. We want to see: evaluation sign-off => onboarding credits, commit sizes => stepped discount, and ramp targets that unlock additional price reductions.
- We also need confirmation on audit log export format (CSV vs JSON) and whether logs include user identifiers (we need pseudonymization options).
- Our security team wants SOC2 evidence and a short list of controls you will enable during the eval. Can you share the SOC2 evidence spreadsheet?

If you can send an updated commercial outline with milestone-linked pricing and a clean SOW we can route to procurement.

Regards,
Clara Hughes
Head of Product Ops | FinServe Inc.
clara.hughes@finserve.com

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: MAP commercial structure & compliance add-ons — proposed terms

Team —

Draft commercial terms to share with FinServe that align pricing to MAP milestones. I put numbers here for negotiation:

Core commercial structure:
- Evaluation: 4 weeks (3/1–3/28). Redwood provides evaluation credits of $6,000 for usage across API calls (applies only to hosted).
- Onboarding target: sign SOW by 3/10, onboarding start 4/1.
- Commit tiers (annual equivalent):
  - Bronze: $60k commit (6mo) => 10% discount on list prices
  - Silver: $120k commit (12mo) => 15% discount
  - Gold: $250k commit (12mo) => 22% discount + 5% rebate if ramp targets met

Compliance/security add-ons (monthly):
- Audit logs export: $2,500/month (includes hourly access to exported logs and S3 storage up to 1TB)
- Extended retention (13 months): $0.12/GB/month beyond included 90-day bucket
- Premium Controls bundle: $1,500/month (RBAC, IP allowlist, HSM connectors)

MAP milestone-linked commercial credits/discounts:
- If evaluation sign-off occurs by 3/30 => one-time onboarding credit equal to 5% of first invoice (applied as credit).
- If SOW executed by 3/10 and commit reaches Silver within 30 days of onboarding => additional 3% uplift discount applied to months 2–6.

Attachments: pricing_table_v2.xlsx, SOW_v2.pdf, SOC2_evidence_list.xlsx

Notes: figures are draft. I recommend offering the audit logs export as an opt-in add-on (separate line item) and be explicit that long-term retention charges are usage-based. If Procurement pushes back on audit logs pricing, we can trade a deeper onboarding credit for an annual commit.

— Neha
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Procurement <procurement@finserve.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Jose Ramirez <j.ramirez@finserve.com>, Clara Hughes <clara.hughes@finserve.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:16:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP commercial structure & compliance add-ons — SOW redlines

Forwarding to the Redwood team — see our redlines to SOW_v2.pdf (attached separately). Key asks:

- Retention: we need the ability to retain logs for up to 24 months for compliance; please confirm if that is possible and if so, pricing/limits.
- Export: audit logs must be exportable in NDJSON and CSV, with a daily export option.
- Data access: pseudonymization must be supported in exports; full identifiers only available under court order.

We can accept the premium controls bundle if the audit logs export pricing is adjusted or if you provide a one-time onboarding credit to offset the first two months of the add-on. Please provide a DocuSign-ready SOW and a final pricing table.

Procurement Team
procurement@finserve.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Hughes <clara.hughes@finserve.com>, Procurement <procurement@finserve.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 15:44:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & evaluation timeline — FinServe (audit logs, retention, premium controls)

Clara / Procurement —

Thanks for the clarity and the redlines. We can accommodate most asks and want to keep the MAP timeline so FinServe can complete the eval in March and onboard in April. Proposed updates:

- Retention: we can extend to 24 months as a custom priced option. Baseline pricing remains $0.12/GB/month for 13 months; 14–24 months is priced on request — for FinServe we can offer a blended rate of $0.09/GB/month for months 14–24 if they agree to a 12-month commit at Silver tier or above.
- Export formats: NDJSON + CSV supported; daily export available. Pseudonymization options will be enabled by default in export; full IDs require an approved legal request.
- Audit logs export: we can reduce the add-on to $1,800/month for FinServe if they sign by 3/10 and commit to Silver or Gold (trade: lower audit log fee for earlier commit).
- DocuSign + SOW: attaching updated SOW_v2.pdf and a DocuSign link — we'll turn on the electronic signature flow once we get verbal confirmation on the commit tier.

MAP milestones and requested dates:
- 3/01: Eval environment available (we will enable 30-day retention during the eval at no charge)
- 3/28: Eval completion and sign-off window (FinServe)
- 3/10: Target date for SOW signature to hit 4/01 onboarding
- 4/01: Onboarding and ramp start

Ask: please confirm sign-off on the MAP items above and whether Procurement is comfortable with the proposed blended retention rate or would prefer a different commercial trade. If you confirm intent to sign Silver or above by 3/10, we will issue the DocuSign SOW and apply the reduced audit-logs fee in the DocuSign terms.

Looking forward — I can hop on a short call tomorrow if that helps finalize.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189
